component.name: Notepad++ Native Linux Port
component.summary: An experimental native Linux port of Notepad++ built with Qt 6 and Scintilla

description.p: An experimental native Linux port of Notepad++ built with Qt 6 and Scintilla, intended to preserve the familiar Notepad++ editing experience on Linux without requiring Wine.
This alpha build is intended for testing and development feedback and is not yet feature-complete.
